evals.prompt: 把已经 concluded 的 UModel Research 转换成技术设计。它需要 API、数据、运维和验证多篇文档。
evals.expected_output: Creates one package-layout DD identity, consumes the concluded Research handoff, and organizes focused DOC members under one atomic review boundary.

assertions.name: package-boundary
assertions.description: Chooses one Design Package instead of treating Research as the design or allocating unrelated DD identities per document.

assertions.name: semantic-handoff
assertions.description: Reproduces findings, confidence, negative evidence, and unknowns rather than keeping only a Research link.

evals.prompt: 这个小型 health endpoint 改动不需要调研，帮我写一个 Design Doc。
evals.expected_output: Creates a single-layout Design only after recording a concrete research-not-required reason and keeps approval separate.

assertions.name: single-layout
assertions.description: Uses a bounded single-file Design when one document can cover the complete contract.

assertions.name: authority-boundary
assertions.description: Does not infer Design approval or ADR acceptance from the request to draft.

evals.prompt: 设计里有身份服务和调用方模块，两者 owner 和发布周期不同，怎么组织？
evals.expected_output: Creates separate DD identities joined by a typed acyclic dependency and keeps package-local DOC IDs for jointly approved topics.

assertions.name: lifecycle-split
assertions.description: Splits independently governed subdesigns rather than nesting one publication lifecycle inside another.

assertions.name: typed-dependency
assertions.description: Uses a typed DD dependency and preserves atomic package approval.
